privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This page explains in plain words what CHCKR does with your data. CHCKR is a prototype built for the AI Builder Cup 2026.

items: Your Google account name and email, when you sign in.
What you share to check: text, links, photos, videos and audio.
How many checks you have used today, for the daily limit.
A notification token for your device, if you allow notifications, so we can tell you when an answer is ready.
Photos, videos and audio you share are deleted automatically within 24 hours.
The text or link you shared is kept with your check, so you can open the answer again from History. It is deleted when you delete your account.

We keep the claims we find in a post and our verdicts. Before they are saved, phone numbers, email addresses, home addresses and names of private people are replaced with [redacted]. This is done automatically and can sometimes miss something. Names of public figures and organisations stay.
Claims and verdicts are shared with all users as fact checks, so the next person with the same forward gets an answer faster.
Recent checks and Trending show only the verdict and the claim text. They never show your photos, videos or audio, your name, or who checked what.
CHCKR runs on Google Cloud. Our servers, database (Firestore) and file storage (Cloud Storage) are in India (Mumbai).
Reading posts and writing answers uses Google's Gemini models on Vertex AI, through Google's global service, which may process data outside India.

Sign-in uses Firebase Authentication. Evidence searches use Google Search and the Google Fact Check Tools API. Images are checked with Google Cloud Vision, and audio answers are made with Google text-to-speech.
To check a link, our server opens the page you shared. That website sees our server, not you.
We record the time and cost of each check with a scrambled user ID. These records never include your name, email or what you shared.
No ads.
We do not sell your data.
We do not share your data with anyone except Google Cloud, which processes it for us.
In the app: tap Settings in the bottom bar, then "Delete my account". This deletes your profile, history, check records and sign-in.
Shared claims and verdicts stay, because they are fact checks for everyone and do not say who asked.
Or email {{email}} and we will delete your account for you.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By using CHCKR you agree to these terms. CHCKR is a free prototype built for the AI Builder Cup 2026.

items: Verdicts are made automatically by AI and can be wrong.
Always open the cited sources before you rely on an answer or forward it.
Do not use CHCKR for medical, legal or financial decisions. Ask a qualified professional.
Each person can make up to {{limit}} checks a day.
Do not try to get around this limit or overload the service.
